title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
blurb: Trained a 1.5B-parameter decoder-only Transformer on a large web corpus and showed it could perform many tasks zero-shot from a prompt.
intro: GPT-2 is the template for modern decoder-only models: byte-level BPE, learned token and position embeddings, pre-LN blocks with causal multi-head attention and a GELU MLP, a final LayerNorm, and an output layer tied to the token embeddings. The steps go from the tokenizer to sampling; the capstone runs the forward pass and generates text greedily, including the context-window crop.
